I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Naib Tehsildar is one of the best Group-B posts open to a plain graduate in Punjab: a Level-6 job in the Revenue Department with a clear path to Tehsildar. This guide puts the official syllabus and exam pattern in one place and tells you what to expect next.

No 2027 notification has been released yet. The rules below are the ones most likely to be repeated; we will update this page as soon as a new notification comes.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Nobody can promise a date, but the history is useful. PPSC filled a large batch of 78 posts in the 2022 cycle (re-examined in June 2023). Tehsildar offices run short of Naib Tehsildars every year through promotions and retirements, so a fresh general-category round is a realistic possibility once the department sends a new demand. The safe plan is to prepare on the official PPSC syllabus below now.

Official notification: PPSC Advt. No. 15

The details below are from the official PPSC Advertisement No. 15 for 78 posts of Naib Tehsildar in the Department of Revenue & Rehabilitation, Govt. of Punjab. A 2027 notification may change the numbers, but the rules usually stay the same.

Download the official PPSC Naib Tehsildar notification, Advt. No. 15 (PDF, 23 pages)

The Government can increase or decrease the number of posts before selection is complete. Women get 33% reservation under the Punjab Civil Services (Reservation for Women) Rules, 2020.

Pay

Rs 35,400 initial pay. During the 3-year probation you get a fixed emolument equal to the minimum pay, without allowances.

Eligibility

  1. Graduate from a recognised university or institution.
  2. Punjabi of Matric or equivalent standard is essential. A ward of defence personnel who is a bona fide resident of Punjab can instead pass a matric-level Punjabi test within two years of appointment.
  3. Nationality: citizen of India (or of Nepal / Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee, or a person of Indian origin, as listed in the notification).

Age limit (as on 01.01.2021 in Advt. No. 15)

  • General: 18 to 37 years
  • SC and BC of Punjab: up to 42 years
  • Punjab Govt. and its boards, corporations, commissions, and all State / Central Government employees: up to 45 years
  • Widows, divorcees and certain other categories of women: up to 42 years
  • Persons with Disability of Punjab: up to 47 years
  • Ex-servicemen of Punjab: may deduct their armed forces service from their age; eligible if the result is not more than 3 years above the upper limit

The fee is non-refundable and was paid through a system-generated challan at any State Bank of India branch.

How to apply

Apply online only at ppsc.gov.in - no other mode is accepted, and you do not send a hard copy to PPSC. In Advt. No. 15 the last date for registration was 08.01.2021 (11:59 PM) and for depositing the fee 15.01.2021 (banking hours). Everyone who applies is treated as provisionally eligible for the written exam; documents are checked after the result.

Official syllabus and exam pattern (PPSC)

This is the official Naib Tehsildar scheme of the Punjab Public Service Commission, from PPSC Advertisement No. 15 (78 posts). Selection is on one objective written exam only - no interview.

SectionQuestionsMarks
General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national and international importance)80200
Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability40100
Total120300
  • Time: 2 hours. Marking: 2.5 marks per question, no negative marking.
  • Minimum to be appointed: 45% (40% for SC and BC of Punjab).

Download the PPSC Naib Tehsildar syllabus (PDF, 2 pages, English + Punjabi)

The full official notification is also available: PPSC Advt. No. 15 (PDF, 23 pages).

1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs (80 questions / 200 marks)

  • Current Affairs: national and international events (mainly the preceding 6-12 months), important days, awards and honours, sports.
  • History & Culture: Ancient, Medieval and Modern Indian History, with special emphasis on the Indian Freedom Struggle; Punjab History & Culture - Sikh Gurus, Sikh rulers, the Bhakti and Sufi movements, and Punjab's role in the freedom struggle.
  • Indian Polity & Constitution: Fundamental Rights and Duties, Directive Principles, Parliament, State Legislatures, Judiciary, Panchayati Raj and constitutional amendments.
  • Geography: physical, social and economic geography of India and Punjab - rivers, soil, climate, agriculture and resources.
  • Indian Economy: economic planning, Union and State Budgets, banking and RBI policies, agriculture and major government schemes.
  • General Science & Environment: everyday science, space and defence technology, ecology, biodiversity and environmental issues.

2. Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability (40 questions / 100 marks)

  • Logical & Analytical Reasoning: coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense, number and alphabet series, syllogisms, analogies, statements & arguments / conclusions, clocks & calendars, ranking, decision making, and non-verbal reasoning (mirror images, cubes & dice, embedded figures).
  • Mental Ability (Quantitative Aptitude): simplification, percentage, ratio & proportion, average, profit & loss, simple & compound interest, time & work, time & distance, boats & streams, problems on ages, HCF & LCM, mensuration (area, volume, surface area), permutation & combination, probability, and data interpretation (charts, graphs, tables).

Our Naib Tehsildar mock test follows this pattern: 40 reasoning and 80 GK questions, 2.5 marks each, no negative marking.

How to prepare

  1. Solve the real papers first. We have the Naib Tehsildar papers of 2022 and 2023 with official answer keys.
  2. GK is two-thirds of the marks (200 of 300). Read current affairs daily and revise polity, economy and geography of India and Punjab.
  3. Punjab history comes up every time. Sikh Gurus, Sikh rulers, the Bhakti and Sufi movements and Punjab's freedom struggle.
  4. Reasoning and maths are 100 marks. Practise daily, timed - series, coding, blood relations, percentage, interest and data interpretation.
  5. Attempt every question. There is no negative marking, so never leave an answer blank.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

Who conducts the Punjab Naib Tehsildar exam?

The Punjab Public Service Commission (PPSC) conducts the Naib Tehsildar exam. It held the 2022 and 2023 papers under Advertisement No. 15 for 78 posts.

What is the qualification for Punjab Naib Tehsildar?

A graduate degree from a recognised university, plus Punjabi of matric or equivalent standard, as per PPSC Advt. No. 15.

What is the salary of a Naib Tehsildar in Punjab?

Rs 35,400 initial pay as per PPSC Advt. No. 15. During the 3-year probation you get a fixed pay equal to the minimum pay, without allowances.

What is the Naib Tehsildar exam pattern?

The official PPSC pattern is one objective paper of 120 questions and 300 marks in 2 hours - 80 GK and current affairs questions (200 marks) and 40 logical reasoning and mental ability questions (100 marks). Each question carries 2.5 marks and there is no negative marking.

Will there be a Naib Tehsildar recruitment in 2027?

No 2027 notification has been published yet. Recruitment depends on vacancies the Revenue Department sends to the board; prepare on the official PPSC syllabus and watch ppsc.gov.in and sssb.punjab.gov.in.
